verdict.label: benign
verdict.description: Postinstall script validates native bindings and installs @swc/wasm as fallback.

behaviors.behavior: Reads package.json to identify target package for postinstall logic.
behaviors.analysis: Script reads INIT_CWD and package.json to determine if it is running in the context of @swc/core or @swc/workspace. This is standard npm postinstall behavior for dependency resolution.
behaviors.impact: Low - Only affects local installation context.

behaviors.behavior: Executes npm install command to download @swc/wasm as fallback if native bindings fail.
behaviors.analysis: The script runs `npm install` with specific flags to download @swc/wasm. It uses a temporary directory and moves the result back, which is a known pattern for ensuring the correct version is installed alongside core.
behaviors.impact: Low - Only installs a dependency that is explicitly needed for functionality.

behaviors.behavior: Uses child_process.execSync to execute npm commands.
behaviors.analysis: The execSync call is used to run npm install with controlled arguments. This is a legitimate way to manage installation logic in Node.js scripts.
behaviors.impact: Low - Only affects local file system and network access for dependency resolution.
